prompt: Compute 17 * 23. Show your reasoning.
response:
To compute the product of two numbers, we can use multiplication:

$$
\begin{align*}
17 \times 23 &= (10 + 7) \times (20 + 3)\\
&= 10 \times 20 + 10 \times 3 + 7 \times 20 + 7 \times 3\\
&= 200 + 30 + 140 + 21\\
&= 391.
\end{align*}
$$

So, $17 * 23 = 391$.
